notes.title: Version 1.1 Released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128149/5a8be7585ec2df42708074eb12fbb361363d26a3.jpg
Hello everyone!
Here is the latest update! I've finally added the chess pieces! It has been on my list for a very long time, but for some reason, this has been delayed for so long! 

Enjoy!


New Piece: Chess pieces added.
New Piece: Chessboard added.
New Piece: Teraboy console added.
New Piece: Magnifier added.
Improved: Physics collision detection.
Improved: Minor lighting adjustments.
Fixed: Selection Render aliasing.

notes.title: Version 0.9 Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
0.8 was meant to be the final one, but we are releasing another to address few issues.


 Added Safe Mode to override graphics settings
 Added new piece red cup.
 Added new piece bowling balls.
 Added "Hide" text to quick overlay.
 Engine upgrade.
 Removed UI Scaling settings and made it automatic.
 Fixed typos in the menu
 Fixed quick overlay not reflecting key changes.
 Fixed DSR related resolution issues.


Also, we are planning to leave Early Access soon like we said in the previous release!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 0.8 Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
With the latest game art update, we are releasing our last patch before full release.


 Added: Support for dynamic resolution.
 Added: Support for nVidia DLSS and AMD FSR.
 Improved: Internal engine update with some CPU performance improvements.
 Improved: Selection overlay and isolation overlay is now more performant.
 Improved: Updated input controller.
 Fixed: Piece count double updating randomly.
 Fixed: Transparent pieces rendering blue.


We are also deprecating the Dev Build completely this patch release and will be preparing for full release some time between January and February next year.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 0.7 Released!
notes.content:
Added: Decorative Christmas balls and variants.

Enjoy!
Note: Dev Build branch will soon be deprecated.

notes.title: Developer Branch Added!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128149/0ac5df69af23627c829c421429bcdbe7efa050fe.jpg
Check this amazing creation by runescape. Subscribe to this piece of art here.

Now that Domino Simulator has reached almost a month and a stable phase, I am splitting the builds into two separate branches.

The first, "Main Build" as a stable, proven build for general play.

and the second, "Developer Build" as a staging branch for new features that needs to be battle tested.

Once the Dev Build accumulates enough content, it will be revised one more time and pushed down as the new Main Build. This usually will happen every month or two depending on the material.

Please note that you will not be able to upload to Workshop from the Dev Build.

Dev Build 0.5 Release Notes You can now rotate pieces anti-clock wise by holding left control
 Added wheel of fortune
 Added hockey puck
 Added anchored hammer
 Added xylophone
 Improved workshop data loading status

notes.title: Version 0.4 Released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128149/d73f873a69e8b961ac49cd245d58a3fd1d94de8b.jpg
Check this amazing creation by ha2rin. Subscribe to this piece of art  here.

Since the release of Domino Simulator, I had so much fun browsing works done by you guys and I have to say that it was really amazing! So, from now on, if I find amazing work on Workshop, I will try to introduce it whenever I have an announcement and this time, it is ha2rin!

Now, let's talk about Version 0.4!

Change Log since initial release
Added video tutorials (in-game) for advanced techniques.
Clear tiles are now frosted, and perform much much better
Added five new locations
Added turn table
Added anchored bridge
Added various ramps
Added half pipe
Added horse piece
Added baseball
Added cricket ball
Added tennis ball
Polished workshop upload workflow.
Improved performance in general.
Improved physics stability at piece resets
Improved physics stability during and after loading a scene
Fixed piece interaction sounds (mostly fireworks) triggering during load
Fixed loaded workshop pieces contributing to total pieces placed
Fixed scenes loaded from workshop not reflecting text details on lightbox.
Fixed stander letter decal overshooting to nearby objects.
Fixed cereal boxes exploding after a reset in some instances.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128149/0894c2f8b4de466a4b4db379079940030cc678b5.jpg
Clear tiles are now frosted. For those who are interested why the clear tiles are now frosted, it is for performance reasons, and it works 4~5 times faster now when many clear tiles are on screen. Clear static panels are not frosted as seen in the screenshot. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128149/e2ab421c18c65cc63974da7a5a800ead64c631c3.jpg
In game video tutorials are added! I guess now the secret of advanced technique is widely available. Take a quick look at it for useful information. The tutorial panel is accessible via a button on the top left corner of the screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128149/3998e55a76baf23561eb139d7fbe4839a6b95b2f.jpg
Another interesting addition is the turntable. I can't wait what this will turn into!

Frequently asked questions

Q: How do I place multiple pieces in a straight line?
A: Press the left SHIFT key and hold it while you place it
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128149/80d014b9ec67910cb9d1013f7879e8b95d60eef8.jpg

Q: How do I change the angle of turret?
A: Some objects have special options that can be set. To set these special options press ESC to clear any selected pieces, then hover over to the object and press the TAB key
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128149/521b3d8000297d122aa1ac2408273b6f21f47fde.jpg

That's it! Enjoy!
